summary.zh: 钓鱼前的消耗品选择，改变等待、命中与目标分布。
summary.en: Pre-cast consumables change waiting, catch odds and target selection.

rules.zh: 玩家准备并装上鱼饵，用持续消耗换取更快或更定向的渔获。不同鱼饵作用不同，成本需要按整次出行计算；玩家通过等待时间与捕获构成判断是否值得继续使用。
rules.en: Prepare and equip bait, spending a consumable for faster or more targeted catches. Different bait types have different effects and trip-wide costs; wait time and catch composition reveal their value.

decisions.zh: 贵鱼饵能省时间，但普通目标未必值得消耗稀缺材料。
decisions.en: Expensive bait saves time, but an ordinary target may not justify scarce materials.

decisions.zh: 这次更需要缩短等待，还是提高目标鱼种的机会？该为哪一种效果付费？
decisions.en: Is shorter waiting or a better chance of the target species more valuable on this trip? Which effect is worth its cost?

effect.zh: 必定消耗便于算成本，概率消耗增加库存不确定性。
effect.en: Guaranteed consumption is predictable; probabilistic use creates stock uncertainty.

effect.zh: 强定向减少无用渔获，弱定向保留意外发现。
effect.en: Strong targeting reduces unwanted catches; weak targeting preserves surprises.

implementation.zh: 普通鱼饵缩短等待；针对性鱼饵提高对应鱼种出现机会，让用途超过单纯提速。
implementation.en: Standard bait reduces waiting, while targeted bait increases the chance of a chosen species, adding a purpose beyond speed.

observation.zh: 钓鱼界面与季节、时间并排显示，提供出钓场景参考；当前鱼饵类型并未在截图中显示。
observation.en: The fishing interface appears beside season and time as trip context; the currently equipped bait is not shown.

implementation.zh: 玩家在钓鱼准备界面选择鱼饵；鱼饵与鱼竿、区域及时间共同影响可以遇到的鱼。
implementation.en: Players choose bait in the fishing setup interface; bait combines with rod, zone and timing to influence potential catches.

observation.zh: 下方可见鱼饵选择栏，上方显示钓点区域；观察消耗品选择被放在抛竿之前。
observation.en: A bait selector sits below the cast-zone display; inspect how consumable selection happens before casting.

contrast.zh: 星露谷用不同鱼饵区分提速与定向目标；守墓人把鱼饵与鱼竿、区域组合用于选择候选渔获。
contrast.en: Stardew separates speed and targeting roles by bait type; Graveyard Keeper combines bait, rod and zone to determine potential catches.

combination.zh: 设计提案：各地区昆虫可制成鱼饵，白天采集路线决定夜间能专门寻找哪些鱼。
combination.en: Design proposal: regional insects become bait, so daytime gathering routes determine which fish can be targeted at night.

setup.zh: 你要找一种稀有鱼，背包里有便宜通用饵和昂贵定向饵。
setup.en: You seek a rare fish and carry cheap general bait plus costly targeted bait.

action.zh: 先确认钓点合适，再用定向饵减少无关渔获。
action.en: Confirm the location is suitable, then use targeted bait to reduce unwanted catches.

result.zh: 每次尝试消耗鱼饵，渔获分布显示投入是否有效。
result.en: Each attempt spends bait; the catch distribution reveals whether it helps.

next.zh: 目标到手后换回便宜饵，把稀缺饵留到下次。
next.en: Switch back to cheap bait once the target is caught and save the rare bait.

firstStep.zh: 做两种效果清楚的鱼饵、可见库存和一组钓鱼结果记录，先不用操作小游戏。
firstStep.en: Use two clearly differentiated baits, visible stock and a catch log; omit the timing minigame initially.

pitfall.zh: 只增加成功率容易变成单线升级；不同鱼饵应服务不同目标并有可见成本。
pitfall.en: A pure success-rate ladder becomes a linear upgrade; bait types need different purposes and visible costs.

test.zh: 切换“随便赚钱”和“找特定鱼”两个目标，玩家是否会换鱼饵？
test.en: Do players change bait when the goal switches from earning money to catching a particular fish?
